items.exampleEn: He was reluctant to leave his old job.
items.exampleZh: 他不太願意離開原本的工作。

items.exampleEn: A car is a necessity if you live in the countryside.
items.exampleZh: 如果你住在鄉下，車子是必需品。

items.exampleEn: The manager is optimistic about next year's sales.
items.exampleZh: 經理對明年的業績很樂觀。

items.exampleEn: You need your parents' consent to join the school trip.
items.exampleZh: 你需要家長同意才能參加校外旅行。

items.exampleEn: Please tell the staff if you see a suspicious bag at the station.
items.exampleZh: 如果在車站看到可疑的包包，請告訴站務人員。

items.exampleEn: The teacher clarified the difficult part with a simple drawing.
items.exampleZh: 老師用一張簡單的圖把困難的部分解釋清楚。

items.exampleEn: There is a contradiction between his words and his actions.
Attending the evening tour is optional.
items.exampleZh: 晚上的導覽可以自由選擇是否參加。

items.exampleEn: The company gave us its assurance that the problem would be fixed.
items.exampleZh: 公司向我們保證問題會被解決。

items.sentenceEn: The manager asked me to clarify a few points in my report.
items.sentenceZh: 經理請我說明報告裡的幾個重點。

items.audioEn: The training course is optional, but most new staff choose to take it.
items.audioZh: 這門訓練課程不是必修的，但大部分新進員工都會選擇參加。
items.questionZh: 這門訓練課程是怎麼安排的？
options: New staff can choose whether to take it

items.sentenceEn: I'm optimistic that we will finish the project on time.
items.sentenceZh: 我很樂觀，相信我們會準時完成專案。

items.sentenceEn: Many workers are reluctant to change the way they do things.
items.sentenceZh: 很多員工不願意改變做事的方式。

items.stemEn: The price seemed too low, so I was ____ of the online seller.
items.stemZh: 價格看起來太低了，所以我對那個網路賣家起了疑心。

items.stemEn: We can't use your photo on our website without your ____.
items.stemZh: 沒有你的同意，我們不能把你的照片放在網站上。

items.passageEn: Last month, our company asked staff to work from the office four days a week instead of two. Many people were reluctant to accept the change, and some were suspicious of the reasons behind it. At a meeting, the manager tried to clarify the plan. She said working together was a necessity for the new project, but she also gave her assurance that Fridays would stay optional. Some staff pointed out a contradiction: the company had praised working from home just a year earlier. In the end, the team gave their consent to try the plan for three months. Most of us are optimistic that it will work.
items.passageZh: 上個月，公司要求員工每週進辦公室四天，而不是兩天。很多人不太願意接受這個改變，有些人還懷疑背後的原因。在一次會議上，經理試著說明這個計畫。她說，新專案需要大家一起工作，這是必要的，但她也保證星期五仍然可以自由選擇。有些員工指出一個矛盾：公司一年前才稱讚過在家工作。最後，團隊同意試行這個計畫三個月。我們大多數人都很樂觀，相信會行得通。

questions.questionZh: 經理說星期五怎麼安排？
options: 自由選擇要不要進辦公室
全公司放假，大家在家休息

questions.questionZh: 有些員工指出了什麼矛盾？
options: 經理自己每週都在家工作兩天
公司一年前稱讚在家工作
辦公室太小，坐不下所有人
新專案其實一年前就結束了

items.promptZh: 你可以說明一下新規定嗎？
referenceEn: Could you clarify the new rules?
Can you clarify the new rules for us?
rubricZh: clarify 後面直接接要說明的事（例如 clarify the new rules）
請求可用 Could you…?、Can you…? 等；寫 explain 意思也對

items.promptZh: 下雨的時候，我們家的貓很不情願出門。
referenceEn: Our cat is reluctant to go outside when it rains.
When it rains, our cat is very reluctant to go out.
rubricZh: reluctant 表示「不情願的」，常用 be reluctant to＋動詞（例如 is reluctant to go out 等）
「出門」可寫，例如 go outside、go out 等
